create.name: Rachel Boucher
create.bio:
Rachel Boucher is an intuitive guide, Reiki Master and meditation teacher based in New Haven, Connecticut, who calls herself a life coach for the soul. She holds a psychology degree from Boston University and a master's in education, and over the years has practised yoga, tai chi and Zen meditation. A long period of exhaustion taught her to trust her own body and intuition again, and that lesson now shapes her teaching for sensitive, deeply feeling people.

Her main tools are Yoga Nidra, affirmations, journaling and gentle energy work, often rooted in nature and the turning of the seasons. She records guided practices for Insight Timer, hosts the podcast Held by the Earth alongside a companion series of nature soundscapes, and sells short self-paced Yoga Nidra and journaling courses online. She also offers remote energy clearings, for individuals and for the chakras, and a course on clearing the energy of a home. Rachel writes books of affirmations and reflective poetry and takes many of the nature photographs on her own site. Free introductory classes on intuition and manifesting give newcomers an easy way in.

courses.title: Guided Reset: Yoga Nidra + Journal Practice
courses.description: A short online course of seventeen lessons combining several Yoga Nidra practices, rest-based affirmations and reflective journaling, with a printable companion. It is meant as a pause you can come back to whenever life feels full.

courses.title: Seasonal Soul Reset: Summer Edition
courses.description: A seasonal course of Yoga Nidra, affirmations and journal prompts themed on summer, with a printable workbook. It invites play, pleasure and reconnection with your own rhythms.

courses.title: Nature Yoga Nidra
courses.description: Four downloadable Yoga Nidra recordings, about eighty minutes in all, using the sounds and imagery of earth, water and wild places to guide you into deep rest.

courses.title: Heal Your House
courses.description: A short course in energetically clearing a home using visualisation, with two videos, worksheets and three guided recordings that walk you through the steps. A bonus video covers smudging.

courses.title: Personal Energy Clearing
courses.description: Thirty minutes of remote energy work focused on what you ask for, with no call needed. Afterwards she emails you a write-up of what she noticed during the session.

courses.title: Individualized Mini Chakra Clearing
courses.description: A shorter remote session focused on the chakras, aimed at releasing what feels stuck and bringing a greater sense of balance.

courses.title: Envisioning Tomorrow: A Guided Journaling Series For Collective Change
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of short audio sessions with journaling prompts, inviting you to imagine a kinder future for yourself and your community, listen to the earth and connect with your future self.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Rachel Boucher on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer page has free affirmation meditations, some with Reiki energy, plus Yoga Nidra and intuition practices. All of the single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Access Your Intuition – free class
free_resources.description: A free seven-day email class with a simple tip or practice each day to help you notice and trust your inner guidance.

free_resources.title: 8 Essential Manifesting Tips – free mini-course
free_resources.description: Eight days of short emails with affirmations, journal prompts and light practices for clarifying what you want and working with the law of attraction.

free_resources.title: Held by the Earth (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of gentle guided audio for sensitive souls, centred on rest and feeling supported by the natural world. A sister show offers real nature soundscapes.
